title: Interstellar Traveller trait evidence and controlled observation

provenance.location: TOPICPOS 1786810 (0x001b43ba), HLP file offset 450991 (0x0006e1af), topic 265 'Interstellar Traveller'
provenance.note: Decoded help topic for Interstellar Traveller; documented-only claim, not a runtime observation.

provenance.location: dialog #149 resource at file offset 0x2fa900, control 278, caption 'Interstellar Traveller'; style 0x50000009 (BS_AUTORADIOBUTTON)
provenance.note: Executable location of the trait name/control is a lead; it does not prove runtime mechanics.

setup.baseline: A custom race with no other selected trait and otherwise identical wizard choices.
setup.variable: Select only Interstellar Traveller and record the advantage-point balance and observable effects.
setup.universe: Single-player, fixed small universe with one Turindrones opponent if the runtime exposes it (otherwise record the actual opponent), fixed difficulty, no random events; keep the same seed/settings across trials.

procedure: Create the baseline race and record the step 1-6 settings and advantage-point balance.
Create the same race with only Interstellar Traveller changed; record the exact advantage-point balance and any disabled controls.
Start the game and record starting technology, planets, fleets, installations and available catalog entries.
Run a controlled comparison for each documented effect, varying one input at a time and repeating at least three trials where randomness may apply.
Record the observed result, game year, settings and any discrepancy from the documented claim.

documented: Starts with two planets with 100/250 stargates in non-tiny universes, Propulsion and Construction tech 5, one scout, one colony ship, one destroyer and one privateer (documented-only).
Exclusive unlimited-range and capacity stargates and the Anti-matter Generator (documented-only).
Can transport minerals and colonists through stargates; cargo weight is ignored for gate limits, and exceeding safety limits is less likely to kill ships (documented-only).
Stargates cost 25% less and reveal planetary statistics for other planets with stargates in range (documented-only).
Mass drivers catch only half their rated minerals, fling less efficiently, and all flung packets decay (documented-only).

unresolved: Gate capacity, overweight risk and the interaction with ship mass are unknown.
Packet decay rates and mass-driver efficiency are unknown.
The executable dialog spells the name 'Inter-stellar Traveler' (lead only).
notes: The help is dated January 1998 and its applicability to stars26i.exe is unverified. No original-game execution is claimed by PR2.
